summary: 19 places and 1360 paths likely, 6 places and 464 paths possible

delta: In the River +3 m indicative scenario, 19 places and 1360 path segments are likely flooded, and 6 places and 464 path segments possibly.
About 141.6 km of mapped paths are likely flooded.
Likely flooded (indicative): Elmina Sales Gallery, Elmina Urban Park, Elmina Valley Central Park and 2 more places, plus 14 small mapped features (shelters, seats, bins, toilets).

Cut off, no mapped way in or out (indicative): RSA Elmina S, Harmoni 1 @ City of Elmina Show Units, Elmina Rainforest Knowledge Centre and 1 more place, plus 5 small mapped features (shelters, seats, bins, toilets).
This is not a forecast; follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance.
